covers.overlap_checked: Live site articles index, content/articles, every desk's drafts and this map, for Glovo, Terrapinn, Teamworks, WPP, Gravitee, Klarna: only Gravitee appears, as one line in S35's press-conference list. S29 names GetVocal and Mastra among eight startups; the case studies are a different angle. The T1 to T5 series and standing answer 12 are not touched.

rules: Standing answers 19, 20, 29 and 30. Every case study is the vendor's own account (GetVocal, Mastra, Gravitee): say so, state no more than the source establishes, no puffery. Connections rest on the vendor's participation (a Web Summit source confirms GetVocal AI and Mastra as featured startups); the customers' participation is not confirmed and must never be implied.

captures.what_is_new: Mastra's case study of Teamworks and PFF's AI assistant for NFL coaches: a routing agent with seven specialist agents; one-shot retrieval failed, validation was added at a cost in speed; still in staging. Mastra's account only, vendor claims.

Mastra's case study of WPP's Developer Studio: a business analyst uploads a call transcript, a Mastra workflow proposes epics, stories and tasks, a person reviews them, the approved output is published into the target Jira environment; client isolation sits in the integration layer (OAuth-authenticated MCP gateway, permissions per user and client), not in the prompt; in internal production in a 100,000-person organisation. Claims are Mastra's and WPP's, not checked. Mastra is on Web Summit's featured startups page.

GetVocal's case study of Glovo's restaurant-partner operations on WhatsApp: check-in messages 15 minutes before opening (response rates up 50%), an uptime agent (uptime up 20% in a six-week evaluation), onboarding and photo-check agents, live within a week, 80 agents in 20+ markets. All GetVocal's claims. GetVocal AI is on Web Summit's featured startups page; Glovo is not confirmed.

GetVocal's case study of Terrapinn's outbound voice agent calling past attendees of its Rail Live event: a protocol-driven, auditable flow chosen over a fully generative one; about 5% conversion benchmark; outcome figures not captured.

Gravitee's State of AI Agent Security 2026 report, a vendor survey of 900+: 80.9% past planning, 14.4% with full security approval, 88% report incidents, 21.9% treat agents as identities. Method not read.

Web Summit's session page for the press conference with Gravitee's CEO, Tuesday 10 November 14:30, Stage 2, media only: 'Collapsing confidence in agent AI security after six months of reality'. Confirms Gravitee's participation.

Klarna's own press release of 27 February 2024: first-month figures of its AI assistant (2.3 million conversations, two-thirds of chats, under two minutes per errand, a human option kept). From 2024; not a Web Summit participant.
